title: Review the export merge request
lead: Robin's export to a file is ready for review. The agent read it overnight: the code is sound, two places need your decision.

v: The change adds **export to a file** to the reports page and moves the heavy part to a background job. The tests pass. What is left is a question of taste and one real risk: [export.ts|file-code] reads the whole table into memory.

parts.sum: Nine files, most of the change is the new job and its tests.

items: The whole table goes into memory. A report of a large account will not fit.
for await (const rows of table.pages(500)) write(rows);
Ten retries of a job that takes minutes can hold the queue for an hour.
A value with a comma inside is not quoted. Worth a test.
